Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Cut Its Holding in Blackrock (BLK) by $569,430; Novartis Ag (NVS) Stock Value Declined While Rockefeller Financial Services Decreased Position by $4.18 Million
May 11, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Blackrock Inc (BLK) by 16.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Llc sold 1,110 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.90% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 5,443 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.80M, down from 6,553 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Blackrock Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $87.23B market cap company. The stock increased 0.86% or $4.61 during the last trading session, reaching $540.87. About 45,025 shares traded. BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) has risen 41.90% since May 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.35% the S&P500.
Rockefeller Financial Services Inc decreased its stake in Novartis Ag (NVS) by 4.76% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rockefeller Financial Services Inc sold 50,324 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.01M shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $84.49M, down from 1.06M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rockefeller Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Novartis Ag for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $182.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $0.56 during the last trading session, reaching $77.5. About 397,483 shares traded. Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) has risen 5.79% since May 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.76% the S&P500.
Among 18 analysts covering BlackRock ( NYSE:BLK ), 12 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. BlackRock had 89 analyst reports since August 26, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Wood on Friday, October 14 with “Market Perform”. The stock of BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, April 13 by Jefferies. RBC Capital Markets maintained BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) on Thursday, January 21 with “Outperform” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by Argus Research on Friday, October 2. Keefe Bruyette & Woods maintained BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) rating on Friday, September 15. Keefe Bruyette & Woods has “Hold” rating and $440.0 target. Barclays Capital maintained it with “Equal-Weight” rating and $375 target in Wednesday, August 24 report. As per Wednesday, September 16, the company rating was upgraded by Gabelli. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Credit Suisse given on Friday, April 13. The rating was maintained by Credit Suisse with “Outperform” on Tuesday, April 12. JP Morgan maintained it with “Overweight” rating and $640 target in Wednesday, March 14 report.
Dumont & Blake Investment Advisors Llc, which manages about $295.66M and $246.36 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 26,105 shares to 26,205 shares, valued at $4.44 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in International Business Machine (NYSE:IBM) by 17,173 shares in the quarter, for a total of 18,773 shares, and has risen its stake in Abbvie Inc (NYSE:ABBV).
